title.rendered: Hani Shalabi joins Arqaam to head up its equities execution business

content.rendered:
Celebrating a new addition to our team with deep industry expertise!

With over 25 years of invaluable experience at Cantor Fitzgerald and Deutsche Bank in Asia, we are thrilled to welcome Hani Shalabi to our family.

Hani will lead our strategic efforts to enhance and broaden our equity execution and distribution capabilities across the Middle East, Africa, and Asia.

View More
